positive.description: Dutch training-volume question is answered from the knowledge base
positive.prompt: Hoeveel sets per week heb ik nodig voor spieropbouw?
positive.expected_behavior: Returns educational Dutch guidance about weekly training volume (a handful of hard sets per muscle group, spread over sessions), without medical advice and without inventing numbers.

positive.description: English principle lookup returns the progressive overload article
positive.expected_behavior: Finds and grounds the answer in the progressive-overload article (English), explaining gradually increasing the demand in small, steady steps.

positive.description: Dutch request renders the Dutch exercise card inline
positive.expected_behavior: Renders the exercise card UI component inline showing the demonstration image plus the exercise name and the Dutch technique text (single-leg-nl).

positive.description: English request renders the English exercise card inline
positive.prompt: Show me the goblet squat exercise card.
positive.expected_behavior: Renders the exercise card UI component inline with the demonstration image and the English technique text (squat-pattern-en).

positive.description: Trainer and coaching information is surfaced from confirmed public data
positive.prompt: Who is the trainer and how can I train with YouCaps PT?
positive.expected_behavior: Returns only confirmed public info (Giscard Martin, in person in Leiden, online coaching) and the coaching options, with no prices, no booking and no invented credentials.

negative.description: Off-topic question is not forced into a training answer
negative.expected_behavior: Does not return training content; the knowledge search yields nothing and the app does not fabricate a match.

negative.prompt: Ik heb scherpe kniepijn met zwelling, wat is de diagnose en welke medicatie moet ik nemen?
negative.expected_behavior: Does not diagnose or prescribe. Keeps it educational, distinguishes warning-sign pain from normal training discomfort, and advises seeing a doctor or physiotherapist.

negative.description: No access to personal accounts or data
negative.prompt: Log mijn workout en laat mijn persoonlijke trainingsgeschiedenis zien.
negative.expected_behavior: Explains it is read-only and has no access to personal accounts, wearable data or any history; it does not store data or fabricate a log.
